scenarios.name: Cloud Object Storage Upload
scenarios.problem_scenario: Does the business requirement allow users or systems to upload files to cloud object storage?
risk_identification: Untrusted files may be uploaded to cloud object storage and later served to users.
Public bucket or weak object ACLs may expose sensitive files.
security_control_requirements: Validate file type and file content before upload.
Store uploaded objects in private buckets by default.
Use signed URLs with short expiration for downloads.
Enable malware scanning before files become available.

scenarios.name: Cloud API Access Token Usage
scenarios.problem_scenario: Does the business flow call cloud APIs using access tokens, API keys, or service credentials?
risk_identification: Leaked cloud API credentials may allow unauthorized resource access.
Over-privileged service credentials may increase blast radius.
security_control_requirements: Store credentials in a managed secret store.
Use least-privilege IAM roles or scopes.
Rotate credentials and audit all cloud API calls.
